features.title: Everything a set needs to become content.
features.subtitle: Not a generic podcast clipper: DJviral is built for music, dance floors and drops.

f1.title: Listens to the set like a DJ
f1.body: The analysis runs on the audio: energy, beat impact and the contrast before and after each drop. The best moments rise to the top.

f2.title: Dynamic cuts on the beat
f2.body: Zooms on the DJ, the crowd and whoever is dancing, with camera changes aligned to the beat. Three intensity levels.

f3.title: Titles that stop the scroll
f3.body: Every clip comes with a ready-made hook for your TikTok or Reels caption, written by AI from the scene.

f4.title: CapCut-style editor
f4.body: Adjust start and end, reframe the shot and add camera keyframes. The clip is re-rendered the way you want it.

f5.title: File or YouTube
f5.body: Upload your set video, up to 3 hours long, or just paste a YouTube link. We handle the rest.

f6.title: A link to share
f6.body: Create a public link for a set so your promoter, club or social media manager can watch and download the clips without logging in.

q1.q: How does the AI pick the clips?
q1.a: It analyzes the audio of the whole set (energy, beat impact and drop contrast), then looks at the picture in the best sections: motion, the DJ and the crowd. The highest-scoring moments become clips.

q2.q: What kind of video can I upload?
q2.a: Any set video up to 3 hours long, as a file or a YouTube link. Clips come out in vertical 9:16.

q3.a: Yes. The free trial includes 1 hour of set and up to 10 clips per set, no credit card required. You only subscribe if you want more hours and more clips.

q4.q: Can I adjust a clip after it is generated?
q4.a: Yes. In the editor you can change the start and end, reframe the shot, zoom and rename the clip. The video is re-rendered with your changes.

q5.q: How long does it take to generate the clips?
q5.a: It depends on the length of the set and the style you pick. Processing runs in the background: you can close the tab and come back later, and the clips will be in your studio.

q6.a: Paid plans renew monthly and are paid by card. You can cancel at any time from the Plan tab in the studio.
